name: laporpak-monorepo
description: LaporPAK! — Platform Pelaporan Infrastruktur & Audit Publik Dua Arah (Techcomfest 2027 - SDG 16)

scripts.build: npx prisma generate && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const d of ['samples','geo','mascots']) { if (fs.existsSync('public/'+d)) fs.cpSync('public/'+d, 'frontend/dist/'+d, { recursive: true }); }"
